answer: Locks are recorded in signal, expire in nectar, and opal lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 133 aliases as a result needs 120 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1115 identities would post 3179 proofs and burn roughly 41 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
